svg.aria-label: Daniel Orelius — Co-Founder & CEO, Entria ApS. I take the manual work out of the cloud. I started as an IT support apprentice in 2017. Ever since, I’ve been doing the same thing at a bigger scale: taking the manual work out of operations. First in the data centre, then in Azure, and now in a company of our own.
